# Job Description: AUTOSAR Lead Engineer **Position Title: ** AUTOSAR LEAD ENGINEER / EMBEBEDDED LEAD ENGINEER (AUTOSAR) **Location: ** [Bangalore] **Employment Type: ** Full-Time **Experience Level: ** 6-10 years ## About the Role We are looking for an experienced AUTOSAR Lead Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and configure embedded software for Automotive Electronic Control Units (ECUs). You will work on production automotive programs, developing AUTOSAR-compliant software components, configuring Basic Software (BSW) modules, and integrating application software with the AUTOSAR stack. You will collaborate with system architects, hardware teams, and OEM/Tier-1 stakeholders to deliver safe, reliable, and standards-compliant automotive software. ## Key Responsibilities ### AUTOSAR Development & Configuration
- Design and develop AUTOSAR Software Components (SWCs) — application layer development based on system requirements.
- Configure and integrate AUTOSAR Basic Software (BSW) modules: COM stack (CAN, LIN, Flex Ray, Ethernet), Memory stack (Nv M, Fee, Ea), Diagnostic stack (Dcm, Dem, Fi M), Mode Management (Bsw M, Ecu M, Com M), OS, and Watchdog.
- Configure the RTE (Runtime Environment) and generate/integrate RTE code.
- Work with AUTOSAR toolchains such as **Vector Da Vinci Developer/Configurator, EB tresos, ETAS ISOLAR, or Mentor VSTAR**.
- Create and maintain ARXML files, software component descriptions, and ECU extract integration.
- Develop and integrate Complex Device Drivers (CDD) where standard modules are insufficient. ### Communication & Diagnostics
- Implement and configure vehicle network communication: **CAN/CAN-FD, LIN, Flex Ray, Automotive Ethernet (SOME/IP)**.
- Configure and validate diagnostics per **UDS (ISO 14229) ** and OBD requirements; implement DTC handling, DIDs, and routines.
- Support network management (NM) and communication matrix (DBC/LDF/ARXML) integration. ### Integration, Testing & Quality
- Perform ECU software integration, build management, and MCAL integration with microcontroller platforms (e.g., Infineon Aurix, NXP, Renesas, TI).
- Debug and analyze issues using tools such as **CANoe, CANalyzer, Lauterbach Trace32, or similar debuggers**.
- Support unit testing, integration testing, and HIL validation activities.
- Ensure compliance with **ISO 26262 (Functional Safety)** processes and support safety analyses (ASIL decomposition, safety mechanisms).
- Follow **ASPICE**-compliant development processes; contribute to requirements traceability using tools like DOORS or Polarion. ## Required Skills & Qualifications
- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
- 6+ years of hands-on experience in **AUTOSAR Classic Platform** development and configuration.
- Strong **Embedded C** programming skills for automotive microcontrollers.
- Solid understanding of the **AUTOSAR layered architecture**: Application layer, RTE, BSW (Services, ECU Abstraction, MCAL).
- Hands-on experience with at least one AUTOSAR toolchain: **Vector Da Vinci, EB tresos, ETAS ISOLAR**, or equivalent.
- Experience with automotive communication protocols: **CAN/CAN-FD, LIN**, and preferably Flex Ray or Ethernet.
- Working knowledge of **UDS diagnostics (ISO 14229) **.
- Familiarity with debugging/measurement tools: **CANoe, CANalyzer, Trace32**.
- Experience with version control (Git/SVN) and requirement management tools (DOORS, Polarion, Jira).
- Understanding of the embedded software development lifecycle in an **ASPICE** environment. ## Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
- Experience with **AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform** (C++, SOME/IP, ara::com).
- Knowledge of **ISO 26262** functional safety up to ASIL-D; experience implementing safety mechanisms (E2E protection, memory partitioning).
- Exposure to **Cybersecurity (ISO 21434) **, Sec OC, and secure boot/flash concepts.
- Experience with **bootloader development** (Flash Bootloader, FOTA).
- Scripting skills in **Python or CAPL** for test automation and tooling.
- Experience with model-based development (MATLAB/Simulink, Embedded Coder, Target Link).
- Domain experience in powertrain, body electronics, ADAS, braking, or battery management systems (BMS).
- Experience working directly with OEMs or Tier-1 suppliers. ## Soft Skills
- Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
- Clear written and verbal communication; ability to work with global, cross-functional teams and customer stakeholders.
- Self-driven with the ability to own modules/features end to end.
- Attention to detail and commitment to automotive quality and safety standards.
